title: scilla bifolia var. secunda
intro: Scilla bifolia var. secunda, commonly known as the Autumn Squill, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Asparagaceae family. It is a perennial bulbous plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Scilla bifolia var. secunda include its ability to treat conditions such as bronchitis, asthma, and coughs due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its sedative and antispasmodic effects, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
